integration_model: Native DoubleCherryGB processes boot ordinary battery saves and execute inputs. Current symbols provide read-only observers. No game RAM writes or emulator-state injection. Test endpoint/checksum copies normalize to the current compiler outputs.

limits: Original full-input p95 targets of 200/300 ms failed. Acceptance was explicitly revised to additional delay after local world motion; measured full-input delay is also retained.
RTT tests use a bounded independent 50-ms one-way TCP bridge. They are not measured WAN or phone latency.
300% validation covers absolute-state convergence in the current presence protocol, not future battle or transfer features.
All 611 maps have a static policy audit; dynamic coverage is representative, not exhaustive gameplay of every map.
Menus/scripts/cameras, overlapping large sprite tiles and unavoidable required actor pressure temporarily defer social drawing.
The 16-bit physical-layout key is a visual hint, not collision-free instance identity or synchronized world progress.
